query:
SELECT 
  m.attendeeId,
  CASE m.attendeeId 
    WHEN '7258470500' THEN 'Mark Brooker'
    WHEN '8713772' THEN 'Alan MacKinnon'
  END as delegateName,
  m.timeSlot,
  CASE m.timeSlot
    WHEN 1 THEN 'Wed 10:15'
    WHEN 2 THEN 'Wed 10:45'
    WHEN 3 THEN 'Wed 13:30'
    WHEN 4 THEN 'Wed 14:00'
    WHEN 5 THEN 'Wed 14:45'
    WHEN 6 THEN 'Wed 15:15'
    WHEN 7 THEN 'Thu 10:30'
    WHEN 8 THEN 'Thu 11:00'
    WHEN 9 THEN 'Thu 13:15'
    WHEN 10 THEN 'Thu 13:45'
    WHEN 11 THEN 'Thu 14:30'
    WHEN 12 THEN 'Thu 15:00'
  END as slotTime,
  s.companyName as sponsor,
  m.id as meetingId
FROM meetings m
JOIN sponsors s ON s.id = m.sponsorId
WHERE m.attendeeId IN ('7258470500', '8713772')
ORDER BY m.attendeeId, m.timeSlot;
